integrity.proof_basis: Symbolic factorization of the period-three dynatomic polynomial and exact resultant identities.

scientific_limitations: The formula is for exact period three only and does not cover periods four and higher.
It is the polynomial discriminant, not a number-field discriminant.
The finite-characteristic interpretation uses the published Hutz–Towsley criterion.
The literature comparison is bounded; independent audit has not been performed.
title: Closed discriminant formula for period-three unicritical parameters
